root.label: Judge Cardone blocks Big Bend border wall construction

events.label: Judge Cardone blocks Big Bend border wall construction

slots.name: construction status
slots.sentence: In a brief order, U.S. District Judge Kathleen Cardone barred the federal government from "construction or ground disturbing activities" in the national park.

slots.name: court ruling outcome
slots.sentence: A federal judge on Friday ruled against the Trump administration's plan to construct a border wall in the Big Bend National Park region of Texas.
